Research

What we work on
01

Foundations of Generative Models

The mathematics of modern generative modelling — flow matching, diffusion, and flow maps, from Riemannian manifolds to discrete spaces.

02

AI for Science

Generative models for scientific discovery: protein design, molecular dynamics, crystal structure prediction, and beyond.

03

Neural Samplers & Boltzmann Generators

Sampling from unnormalized densities, iterated energy matching, and amortized inference.

04

Safety & Robustness

Adversarial machine learning and red-teaming of large language models.
